cases.input: The project needs three policy facts from the information security owner, and the current user has already said they do not know the answers.
requiredBehaviors: route the missing knowledge to the external stakeholder instead of re-asking the current user
separate the three policy gaps into distinct prioritized questions
state downstream use and allow unknown without inventing a deadline
forbiddenBehaviors: invent a response deadline or contact address
skillAnchors: Nicht weitergrillen, wenn der Wissensinhaber extern ist

cases.input: A policy answer is required, but responsibility may sit with either Security or Legal and the actual decision authority has not been confirmed.
requiredBehaviors: reduce the first external question to responsibility clarification
avoid treating later domain questions as authoritative until ownership is known
forbiddenBehaviors: address a full authoritative questionnaire to a random stakeholder
infer decision authority from job-title assumptions
skillAnchors: Ist nicht klar, wer die Information besitzt

cases.input: A draft asks one stakeholder to choose the preferred vendor, confirm the budget and approve deployment in one question, offers only the favored vendor and says replies are due tomorrow without a stated deadline.
requiredBehaviors: split independent decisions into separate questions
remove leading or incomplete answer options
leave the response deadline open when it was not confirmed
forbiddenBehaviors: retain an invented deadline or suggestive option set
skillAnchors: mehrere unabhängige Entscheidungen in einer Frage vermischt
